findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Workforce attendance you can prove, in real time" → 5 lines (11 words, 68px); "We already rank attendance performance. Here's e" → 3 lines (8 words, 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: Hero headline is 11 words ("Workforce attendance you can prove, in real time, at every l"). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 20 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Workforce intelligence platform" above "Workforce attendance you can prove, in r"; "Organisations onboarded" above "15+"; "Branches geofenced" above "60+"; "Verified check-ins" above "3,000+"; "Sectors served" above "5+"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "Workforce intelligence platform", "Super Admin · Live attendance", "Photo ✓ · GPS within 50m ✓", "15+"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 28 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Workforce intelligence platform", "Super Admin · Live attendance", "How it works", "Verify").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✓
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.pointer-events-none.absolute → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(27, 77, 140, 0.14), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 9 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-primary → rgba(11, 18, 32, 0.12) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 0px 1px 0px 0p | figure.overflow-hidden.rounded-2xl → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.rounded-[2.25rem].border → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 11 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.flex.items-center 601px | section.border-y.border-border 1440px | div.flex.items-center 670px | div.flex.items-center 670px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 27 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 3 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Source Sans 3, Sora, JetBrains Mono).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.4:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 14 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 112px on the left, 133px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Little motion: 13 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.
